lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular clusters arranged in quasi-linear rows posterior to the branchial region, extending along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a visible grid-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature running across the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of high-luminance blobs visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a dark, elongated silhouette consistent with a remora (Echeneidae) attached ventrolaterally posterior to the pectoral fin.
